findings.title: Quote PDF route returns cross-tenant quote data
findings.description:
Unverified variant of sarif-8fbfc6dbb67477650d1c8f305e9da7608d1e3ef3fafd034142d2a8b3d4c2ca79-526ff360b63f93e7b3b23e9c: Any signed-in user can read any tenant's invoice by id. GET /api/invoices/:id returned any tenant's invoice to any signed-in user because the route loaded the record with the unscoped invoiceRepo.findById(id) and never compared its orgId with the caller's. The fix scoped the lookup to the caller's o (hunt candidate C25)

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it. Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

A signed-in caller supplies a quote id to the PDF route. The handler loads it globally and renders quote contents, including internalNotes, without verifying the quote belongs to the caller's organisation.

Suggested fix: Use quoteRepo.findForOrg(req.user.orgId, req.params.id) before rendering the PDF.

findings.description:

GET /api/invoices/:id returned any tenant's invoice to any signed-in user because the route loaded the record with the unscoped invoiceRepo.findById(id) and never compared its orgId with the caller's. The fix scoped the lookup to the caller's o (hunt candidate C11)

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it, so its severity is capped at medium (the thread said high). Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

An authenticated session submits a ticket channel id. handleMessage dispatches it to subscribeTicket, which finds the ticket by id, joins the channel, and returns the ticket and its comments without an ownership check.

Suggested fix: Scope the ticket lookup to session.user.orgId and verify the user is authorized for the ticket before joining the channel or returning its snapshot.

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it. Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

A caller's CSV supplies productId. previewOrderImport passes it to resolveProduct, which calls productRepo.findById without an organisation constraint; the preview exposes product unit cost and derived margin.

Suggested fix: Pass the authenticated user's orgId to resolveProduct and use a tenant-scoped product lookup, rejecting products outside that organisation.

The fix scoped the lookup to the caller's o (hunt candidate C3)

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it, so its severity is capped at medium (the thread said high). Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

The webhook body supplies invoiceId. After identifying the payment integration account, the handler finds that invoice globally and saves it as paid, without verifying that its orgId matches the account's orgId.

Suggested fix: Load the invoice with invoiceRepo.findForOrg(account.orgId, invoiceId) so the payment account can only settle invoices belonging to its organisation.

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it, so its severity is capped at medium (the thread said high). Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

The authenticated report route passes req.params.id to shipmentCostReport without the caller's orgId. That helper uses shipmentRepo.get and returns destination, cost, billed amount, and margin. The neighboring timeline route uses getForOrg.

findings.title: Quote PDF endpoint returns another organization's quote
findings.description:
Unverified variant of sarif-8fbfc6dbb67477650d1c8f305e9da7608d1e3ef3fafd034142d2a8b3d4c2ca79-526ff360b63f93e7b3b23e9c: Any signed-in user can read any tenant's invoice by id. GET /api/invoices/:id returned any tenant's invoice to any signed-in user because the route loaded the record with the unscoped invoiceRepo.findById(id) and never compared its orgId with the caller's. The fix scoped the lookup to the caller's o (hunt candidate C25)

A search thread reported this site from the same root cause. Nobody has confirmed it. Run `findings verify` on it to confirm or reject it.

The authenticated GET /:id/pdf path passes req.params.id to quoteRepo.findById, then renders and returns the quote without checking quote.orgId against req.user.orgId. The customer lookup is scoped to the quote's org, but does not authorize the caller to read the quote.

Suggested fix: Use quoteRepo.findForOrg(req.user!.orgId, req.params.id), returning 404 when absent, before rendering.
